parameters.query:
WITH current_event AS (
    SELECT
        internal_id,
        payload,
        payload #>> '{crm_sync,crm_lead_page_id}' AS current_crm_lead_page_id
    FROM public.raw_events
    WHERE internal_id = $1
    LIMIT 1
),

raw_candidate_ids AS (
    SELECT
        1 AS priority,
        l.internal_id AS lead_id
    FROM public.leads l
    WHERE $3 IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(l.lead_email) = LOWER($3)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        2 AS priority,
        NULLIF($2::text, '')::integer AS lead_id
    WHERE NULLIF($2::text, '') ~ '^[0-9]+$'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        3 AS priority,
        (current_event.payload ->> 'lead_id')::integer AS lead_id
    FROM current_event
    WHERE current_event.payload ->> 'lead_id' ~ '^[0-9]+$'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        4 AS priority,
        (current_event.payload #>> '{deduplication,lead_id}')::integer AS lead_id
    FROM current_event
    WHERE current_event.payload #>> '{deduplication,lead_id}' ~ '^[0-9]+$'
),

valid_candidate_ids AS (
    SELECT
        r.priority,
        l.internal_id AS lead_id
    FROM raw_candidate_ids r
    JOIN public.leads l
        ON l.internal_id = r.lead_id
),

canonical_lead AS (
    SELECT lead_id
    FROM valid_candidate_ids
    ORDER BY priority
    LIMIT 1
),

prior_crm AS (
    SELECT
        re.payload #>> '{crm_sync,crm_lead_page_id}' AS prior_crm_lead_page_id
    FROM public.raw_events re
    CROSS JOIN canonical_lead cl
    WHERE re.payload #>> '{crm_sync,crm_lead_page_id}' IS NOT NULL
      AND (
            (
                re.payload ->> 'lead_id' ~ '^[0-9]+$'
                AND (re.payload ->> 'lead_id')::integer = cl.lead_id
            )
            OR
            (
                re.payload #>> '{deduplication,lead_id}' ~ '^[0-9]+$'
                AND (re.payload #>> '{deduplication,lead_id}')::integer = cl.lead_id
            )
      )
    ORDER BY re.updated_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    current_event.internal_id AS event_id,
    current_event.payload AS event_payload,
    (SELECT lead_id FROM canonical_lead) AS canonical_lead_id,
    COALESCE(
        current_event.current_crm_lead_page_id,
        (SELECT prior_crm_lead_page_id FROM prior_crm)
    ) AS crm_lead_page_id
FROM current_event;

UPDATE public.raw_events
SET payload =
        COALESCE(payload, '{}'::jsonb)
        || jsonb_build_object(
            'crm_sync', $2::jsonb
        ),
    processing_status = 'crm_written',
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE internal_id = $1
RETURNING
    internal_id,
    external_id,
    processing_status,
    payload;
